name: Steve Biko
shortBio: South African anti-apartheid philosopher and founder of the Black Consciousness Movement who argued that political liberation requires overcoming psychological servitude first.
centralQuestion: Why is the most potent weapon in the hands of the oppressor the mind of the oppressed, and how does Black Consciousness reclaim existential agency?

keyWorks.title: I Write What I Like
keyWorks.description: Posthumous collection articulating Black Consciousness as an existential philosophy of self-definition, solidarity, and critique of white liberalism.
